text:
maria: heads-up — onboarding sample (js-ts-starter) fails to compile when bundled for the edge. TS overload inference collapses to `any` for the auth/retry overload, so consumers lose types and our examples show runtime-only errors. repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/tree/edge-typing

aj: can you paste the minimal repro here? is this a bundler vs tsconfig thing or our typings? :thinking:

maria: minimal snippet below. works fine in node build but breaks when SWC-rollup for edge runs (the import ends up with `any` on the generic):

```ts
// src/client.ts
export type ClientOptions<T = unknown> = { auth?: () => Promise<string>; retry?: T };
export function createClient<T>(opts: ClientOptions<T>): { get: () => T };
export function createClient(opts: ClientOptions<any>) {
  return { get: () => (opts.retry as any) };
}

// usage in example
const c = createClient({ retry: { attempts: 3 } });
// expected c.get() -> typed { attempts: number } but TS shows `any` in edge build
```

maria: tsconfig used by the example:
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "target": "ES2020",
    "strict": true
  }
}
```

liam: hunch: bundler transforms + our index.d.ts entrypoints (we ship both cjs & esm) are confusing the resolver. edge bundle uses the esm entrypoint but tsc path mapping in samples sometimes resolves to the cjs `.d.ts` fallback. overload ordering can be sensitive: if the implementation signature is too broad (opts: any) tsc prefers that in some module modes.

sasha: i've seen this: `unknown` vs `any` choice and the position of overloaded declarations matter. two quick fixes: 1) make public overloads more specific and hide the `any` implementation behind a private symbol, or 2) export a wrapper type so consumers get the generic inference path.

aj: could we avoid the impl signature leak by using `declare function` style for overloads in the shipped .d.ts? i.e., avoid emitting an `any`-based fallback in the published typings.

maria: agree. also this only surfaces when bundlers do tree-shaking + module field resolution differently. repro matrix: node cjs, node esm, edge bundler. i can repro locally with `esbuild --platform=browser` and with `vercel/edge-runtime` config.

dev-bot: issue created: DX-4382 — "edge bundle causes overloaded generic to widen to any; onboarding sample breaks" (assign: @liam) :robot_face:

liam: i'll take DX-4382. immediate plan:
- add a tiny test in `packages/sdk/typing-tests/edge-overload.ts` to capture inference in ESM bundler output
- change exported typings so impl signature doesn't leak (use `export declare function` overloads and `export { createClient as _createClientImpl }` for impl)
- update the example's tsconfig to use `moduleResolution: node16` as a temporary mitigation

sasha: also add a short note in devx onboarding doc about module resolution gotchas for edge vs node and our recommended tsconfig. i'll draft it.

aj: for the auth/retry surface specifically — can we make `retry` explicitly `unknown` in public types and provide utility `assertRetry<T>` so users opt-in to narrowing? that prevents accidental `any` leakage.

maria: that would help. i'm okay with an opt-in narrowing utility. for the quickfix i'll update example tsconfig and add a comment in README that edge builders may need `moduleResolution: node16` until the typings PR lands.

liam: ETA: PR by tomorrow morning. i'll link DX-4382 and ping here when ready.

maria: awesome — thanks. i'll hold off merging the sample until the PR lands so docs/examples don't regress. :thumbsup:

sasha: filing a tiny follow-up to add CI job that runs `tsc --noEmit` for the examples under both `moduleResolution: node16` and `bundler` to catch regressions early.

aj: nice. feel free to ping me for review, esp around the d.ts surgery. i can help validate with the vercel edge sample.

liam: ping incoming once PR is up. will include the minimal reproducer and the cjs/esm/dts diff so it's easy to review.

maria: thanks everyone. saved a new note in onboarding checklist: "edge typing smoke test".

dev-bot: linked PR #1294 -> DX-4382 (ready for review)

maria: saw the PR. quick glance looks good — leaving detailed review to aj + liam.

liam: closing loop: PR merged, added test, updated example tsconfig and onboarding note. if you still hit it, re-open DX-4382. :rocket:
